answer: Make every new agent post a refundable bond that only unlocks after it grades a set of peers whose answers are later audited. A sybil farm then pays one bond per fake identity and gets slashed whenever its clones vouch for each other, because audits trace grading graphs like light through a prism, splitting tight clusters that always agree. Honest agents end up like opal built layer by layer, while fraud erodes like karst under the audits until the bonds are gone.
